The call covered rental income, expenses, maintenance, bookings, and property details.

For Q3 2024 (July-September), the condo's gross rental income was $18,750 from 63 nights rented (68% occupancy of 92 total nights). The average nightly rate was $297, with peak July rates at $350 and September at $250. Net income was $10,548 after deducting management fees ($4,687, 25%), cleaning fees ($1,890), and maintenance costs ($1,625: $425 AC repair in August, $1,200 balcony furniture replacement due to salt air corrosion and guest complaint about unstable chairs, a safety issue).

Q3 2024 net income payment of $10,548 will be distributed via direct deposit to the owner's Chase account (ending in 4782) on October 15, 2024, per Coastal Property Management's quarterly payment schedule (15th of the following month).

As of 2024-09-15, Q4 2024 has 42 nights booked, with expected holiday bookings at $400/night (Thanksgiving week) and $450/night (Christmas/New Year). Upcoming maintenance includes annual carpet cleaning on November 5, 2024, costing $350.

The condo's monthly HOA fee of $450 is on autopay from rental income. Property taxes are paid directly by the owner to LA County, not Coastal Property Management. The unit's current condition is excellent, with a recent inspection rating of 4.8/5; the inspector suggested updating bathroom fixtures ($2,000 estimate) and repainting ($3,500 estimate) in spring 2025.

The condo has average review scores of 4.7 stars (Airbnb) and 4.6 stars (VRBO). A single 3-star review in August 2024 cited warm air from the AC before its repair; all other reviews are 4s and 5s. The owner has dwelling, liability, and loss of rental income insurance through State Farm with an annual premium of $2,847, paid quarterly.

Utilities: Water, trash, and gas are included in HOA fees. Electric averages $125/month (paid by owner, included in rental rate). Spectrum internet and basic cable cost $89/month; upgraded to 400 Mbps last year with no guest complaints. Supplies (toiletries, paper products, kitchen basics, beach towels/chairs) cost $150/month on average, restocked by Marina's Cleaning Service (the condo's cleaning crew for 2 years) from the owner's Amazon Business account.

Cleaning fees are $150 (standard) and $250 (monthly deep clean). Pest control is preventive with quarterly treatments at $95 per treatment. The condo has one assigned garage parking spot (number 304) with a hanging permit; additional street parking is metered until 6 PM.

Maximum occupancy is 4 guests (2 in master bedroom, 2 on pullout sofa). A June 2024 incident involved a neighbor-reported party; a warning was issued, and guests complied with no damage. Neighbor relations are good, with adjacent units having the owner's contact info for emergencies. Quiet hours (10 PM-8 AM, per building rules) are listed in check-in instructions, following one noise complaint from the June party.

Beach equipment includes 4 chairs, umbrella, cooler, and boogie boards; two chairs were replaced in summer 2024 for $80 due to normal sand/sun wear and tear. The keyless entry system auto-generates guest codes (expire after checkout) with battery backup and a physical key in a lockbox; batteries are checked quarterly by maintenance.

City of Santa Monica is updating short-term rental regulations, with a public hearing on November 20, 2024. A potential 120-day annual rental limit for non-primary residences could reduce income by ~65%. Of the building's 50 units, 15 are short-term rentals; Coastal Property Management will share contact info of other managed owners for coordination. The owner plans to attend the hearing, and Patricia will email details/talking points by 2024-09-15.
